mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial expansion (INDPRO > 110.0), manufacturing output growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, which reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment growth rate below 0.1% signals weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand for housing and related goods, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1900.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index, 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
